title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds
summary: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified.
